caption_id.view_id_assignment: Both renderers pass 0x7f0b0b55 to LX/7oV;->A0G(LX/09S;I)LX/09S;. Its legacy property LX/7oW;->A0S is VIEW_ID; modern property LX/moK;->AV8 invokes android.view.View.setId(int).
